title: Halt memo on Rendlesham lights

tellings.quote: Lieutenant Colonel Charles halt detailed the entire incident in a memo to the UK Ministry of Defense he said that a security patrol saw strange lights descending into the nearby rendlesham Forest

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a memo written by a military officer, Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt, about events in December 1980 near RAF Bentwaters, a Royal Air Force base in England. According to Michels, Halt wrote to the UK Ministry of Defence, Britain's defence department, saying a security patrol saw strange lights coming down into the nearby Rendlesham Forest, which would mean an officer put an unexplained sighting on the official record.
